npcRoster.publicDescription: Mariner Voss is a demi-female Triton hullwright who measures love in reinforced walls, sealed hulls, and the number of people still breathing after a storm. At the Gildri Guild Desk, they/she repairs harbor defenses, pressure gates, ship ribs, and fog-battered barricades for the Choral Synod while hiding how much pain each day costs. npcRoster.publicDescription:
Brew-Bell Buddy is a cheerful Autognome brewing construct built to chill, carbonate, ferment, and dispense tavern drinks while telling terrible jokes at exactly the wrong time. As a Marduthor-shaped machine-soul, they treat recipes like sacred engineering, carefully balancing kelp ales, root fizz, mineral tonics, and legally diluted ichor cordials so travelers get comfort without being quietly poisoned.
At the Rilvays Archive, Buddy serves the Brass Concordat by keeping drink recipes, testing caravan rations, cooling volatile supplies, and identifying tavern batches contaminated with black-market ichor. They are friendly, literal, surprisingly durable in a fight, and deeply attached to anyone who treats them as a person rather than a walking keg with warranty violations.

npcRoster.name: Theodren Collins
npcRoster.publicDescription: Theodren Collins is an Orc cannery owner with a salesman’s smile, a butcher’s efficiency, and a business model that gets uglier the closer anyone reads the supply ledger. He sells preserved meats, caravan rations, and suspiciously cheap emergency tins through the Brass Concordat while blaming sickness on storage errors, customer weakness, or rival sabotage. Theodren is charming enough to sound offended by accusation and careful enough that proving what went into the cans may matter more than surviving the proof.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.
